According to the Seventh Central Pay Commission, LTC can be availed by the Government servant for self and his/her family members during Leave, but the return journey should be completed within six months from the date of outward journey. As per LTC rules, Central Government employees are allowed to travel to their Home Town along with their families on one occasion in a block of four year.
He/ She may (i) intimate the date of commencement of the outward journey to the undersigned before proceeding to his / her Home Town / Declared Destination and (ii) furnish Air/railway ticket numbers / bus tickets at the time of filling his / her LTC claim (no relaxation in respect of furnishing of Air/railway ticket numbers / bus tickets is permissible).
Travel by private Bus / Taxi is not permissible. Travel through shortest route only will be admissible. Unutilized portion of advance should be returned after booking of tickets or 10 days from the date of drawl of advance whichever is early, otherwise it will attract interest from the date of drawl of advance to the date of recovery. When advance is taken, the claim should be submitted within one month from the date of return journey. If not, outstanding advance will be recovered in one lump sum and the claim will be treated as one where no advance is sanctioned. Further, Penal interest at 2% over GPF interest on the advance from the date of drawl to the date of recovery will be charged. When no advance is taken, claim should be submitted within three months from the completion of return journey. Otherwise the claim will be forfeited

Sd/-
